name: claude-toolbar
description: Buttons at the top right of the Claude Code chat in VS Code, after the chat's context size as text (such as 212k). One switches Claude's Focus view on and off; one shows or hides the Chat colors pane, which sets the color of the chat's prompt outline and thinking lines as VS Code theme colors.

commands.title: Chat in Focus view (Claude's work folded). Click to show everything.
Chat shows everything. Click for Focus view (Claude's work folded).
Chat colors: show or hide the pane that colors the prompt outline and the thinking lines.

claudeToolbar.contextRefreshMs.description: Context size: how long to wait after Claude writes to the chat before reading its size again, in milliseconds.

claudeToolbar.contextTailBytes.description: Context size: how many bytes of the end of the chat's transcript are read to find its latest size. Raise it if the size shows 0k while Claude answers with very long tool results.

scripts.build: npm run manifest && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json && tsx scripts/copy-media.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && tsc -p tsconfig.webview.json --noEmit
scripts.package: tsx scripts/clean-dist.ts && npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --skip-license --allow-missing-repository --out claude-toolbar.vsix
